translation:
Koizumi is very good at giving compliments,
isn't he?

Agreed. He's the most worldly and
sophisticated member.

Do you think being better at complimenting
people would be useful in various ways?

You don't need to worry about it—you're fine
just focusing on your airhead allure.

The fact you're unaware of it makes it even
better. You don't need to flatter anyone.
